records.summary: Verified Coinbase's two distinct XRP collateral pathways: XRP is accepted as collateral for Coinbase Global Exchange perpetual-futures margin, with haircut/ADQ caps and automatic liquidation rules; separately, Coinbase offers Morpho-backed USDC loans using XRP represented as cbXRP on Base. Coinbase does not disclose XRP-specific posted collateral, haircuts or loan balances, and loan proceeds cannot be used for trading on Coinbase. Circle's Arc launch announcement directly lists SBI Group as a founding validator, Coinbase as an exchange-access partner and Morpho as a credit-layer participant; Arc is a USDC-gas network distinct from XRPL. TradRadar's 05:40Z XRP snapshot reports $1.85B OI across seven exchanges, +0.28% 24h OI change, +0.0058% funding/8h, $1.2454 mark price (-1.06%) and 78.5% long accounts; no feature admitted. XRP Insights' 08:00Z Oct30 XRPL-labeled wallet snapshot reports Binance 2.58B XRP across 153 wallets with -173.2M same-wallet 7d change and Coinbase 5.84B across 358 wallets; totals include 327.4M Binance-Peg XRP reserve and 151.4M cbXRP backing reserve, so these are not customer free-float measures. This provider-specific series differs from CryptoQuant's narrower reserve series; the prior 220M reserve-decline/233.46M theft magnitude match remains a hypothesis, not a reconciled fact. Official Tokyo SBIC confirms the 2026-10-06 generative-AI seminar context; it was educational, not an OpenAI partnership. Repository audit found an unsafe Databricks token workflow accepting new_token and interpolating it into a shell command; PR #1398 disables the input, sets permissions empty and replaces it with a no-op diagnostic. Exact-head CI passed 344 tests plus 8 subtests; fail-closed gate passed with merging disabled. Main is protected=true, but required status-check contexts are empty and full protection settings were inaccessible. Targeted workflow review covered 24 of 77 active YAML files; manual write workflows remain for separate review. No market feature admitted and no forecast issued. A new push-event failure of the approval workflow returned zero jobs (run 41177228657) although the inspected workflow declares workflow_dispatch only; no job logs exist and root cause remains unknown. The research-branch exact-head validator did not produce a run for the latest head, so full repository validation remains pending.
